§3 RNN · hₜ = tanh(W_hh·hₜ₋₁ + W_xh·xₜ + b)
one shared W; h carries memory

span.p:
§5–6 ∂L/∂h_k = ∂L/∂h_T · Π W_hhᵀ · diag(1 − hₜ²)
ρ(W_hh) < 1 → vanish · > 1 → explode · 0.9¹⁰⁰ ≈ 0.0000265 → dead
